Sandbox_ALifeStartWithNPC.Enabled_toolti: When ON, every new character begins with friendly NPCs at their side. Existing saves are never touched: the grant happens once per character, and the flag is stored on that character.
Sandbox_ALifeStartWithNPC.Count_tooltip: How many friendly NPCs to grant at character creation. Keep this low: each one is a full A-Life NPC with its own AI, gear and inventory.
Sandbox_ALifeStartWithNPC.Mode_tooltip: Companion (default) spawns a friendly A-Life NPC that A-Life itself orders to follow you. Resident hands the NPC to the Jeem Extension resident system instead: it gets a camp post, tasks and standing, but residents guard their base - they do NOT follow you. Companion needs no base and no side effects.
Sandbox_ALifeStartWithNPC.Distance_toolt: How far from the player the NPCs appear. Too close can shove the player; 2-3 tiles is usually right.
Sandbox_ALifeStartWithNPC.FactionId_tool: Leave empty to let the game pick a friendly faction. Otherwise enter an exact faction id from the A-Life catalog (for example alife_kettle) or one of your own Creator factions. Unknown ids are reported in the console and skipped.
Sandbox_ALifeStartWithNPC.ProfileId_tool: Leave empty to pick a profile from the chosen faction. Otherwise enter an exact member id from the catalog. Unknown ids are reported in the console.
Sandbox_ALifeStartWithNPC.Resident_Creat: Create a camp if you have none

Resident mode needs a base (camp) to assign the NPC to. When ON and you have no base yet, a small camp is created around your spawn point - it uses one of your Jeem base slots. Turn this OFF if you prefer to build your own camp first; the NPC then spawns as a plain companion instead.
Sandbox_ALifeStartWithNPC.GrantOnRespawn: When ON, a character created after dying also starts with NPCs. When OFF, only the very first character of a save gets them.
Sandbox_ALifeStartWithNPC.DebugLog_toolt: Prints one line per step of the grant (hook fired, waiting for square, actor created, resident conversion, fallback used). Turn it off once it works.
Sandbox_ALifeStartWithNPC.MakeAllied: Start allied with that NPC's faction
Sandbox_ALifeStartWithNPC.MakeAllied_too: When ON, the granted NPC's faction is pushed to the top of the Jeem standing ladder (ALLIED) the moment it spawns, and its crew is flagged allied too. This is what makes it a true 同盟: it will never turn on you, and the Jeem resident system accepts it without needing admin force. Note that standing is tracked PER FACTION, so the whole faction becomes allied with you, not just the one NPC. Turn OFF if you want to earn their trust normally.
